title: Return a structured InterlockingResolution from resolveTrain, not a bare trainId

facts.note: Requires a code observer detecting an InterlockingRunner that exposes a resolveTrain method anywhere in the Bun runtime code (the existing detector only scans src/trains/**/*.ts; that is detector coverage, not an exemption).

fires: A Bun InterlockingRunner exposes resolveTrain and it returns a bare trainId string.
A Bun InterlockingRunner exposes resolveTrain and no InterlockingResolution type/interface/class exists.
A Bun InterlockingRunner exposes resolveTrain and the InterlockingResolution model lacks one of the eight required fields.
An existing, unchanged resolveTrain on a Bun InterlockingRunner still returns a bare trainId.
doesNotFire: No InterlockingRunner or no resolveTrain method exists (that is coder.bun.interlocking-runner-exists).
Non-Bun stacks (covered by the agnostic core obligation or other stack realizations).

given: A Bun/TS InterlockingRunner exposes a resolveTrain(...) method
then: resolveTrain resolves a structured InterlockingResolution model defining interlockingId, routeId, trainId, trainPath, category, guardId, resolutionStrategy, and reason — not a bare trainId string.
prefer: `export interface InterlockingResolution { interlockingId: string; routeId: string; trainId: string; trainPath: string; category: string; guardId: string; resolutionStrategy: string; reason: string; }`
Define the model and return it from resolveTrain: `return { interlockingId, routeId, trainId, trainPath, category, guardId, resolutionStrategy, reason, };`
avoid: Resolving only a bare trainId string from resolveTrain.
Judging category agreement from a digit parsed out of the identity validation instead of the target train's `category` field.
unless: No InterlockingRunner with a resolveTrain method is present (separate coder.bun.interlocking-runner-exists concern).
why: A bare trainId loses the routeId, guardId, category, resolutionStrategy, trainPath and the human-readable reason needed for trace and projection equivalence.
evidence: The Bun detector (coverage: src/trains/**/*.ts) finds an InterlockingResolution type/interface/class whose collected property names include all eight required fields whenever an InterlockingRunner exposes resolveTrain.
Reviewer confirms resolveTrain returns the structured model (typecheck conformance is proven by the runs_alongside rule coder.bun.runtime-typecheck-enforced).
Reviewer confirms category agreement is checked against the target train's `category` field.
verifier_detail: Detector coverage: scans src/trains/**/*.ts. Trigger: an InterlockingRunner exposes resolveTrain. Requirement: an InterlockingResolution type, interface, or class exists defining the eight fields interlockingId, routeId, trainId, trainPath, category, guardId, resolutionStrategy, reason; otherwise report that the route is resolved as a bare trainId. The scan scope is a detector implementation boundary; it does not exempt runners elsewhere from the runtime obligation.

Field recognition (Bun): collect the property names declared on InterlockingResolution; an interface, type alias, or class with the same eight fields all satisfy the detector. WHICH runtime files are inspected and HOW the model fields are recognized is the per-stack detector's concern, not the agnostic obligation.
Detector: member of the bun_interlocking_infrastructure FAMILY detector, checks/interlocking_resolution_model.mjs; implementation type validator, ref coder.bun.interlocking-resolution-model-exists.
Disposition strict, severity 4: a resolveTrain backed only by a bare trainId is not suppressible and fails CI.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.1.0.

Bun-stack realization of the agnostic core obligation coder.train.interlocking-resolution-model-exists (core afokapu/atdd#1251), an agnostic "structured route resolution" obligation rendered for the Bun application; enforced by the atdd.workspace.bun JS detector.
Core runtime spec afokapu/atdd#1251 suggests the resolution model.
Term interlocking_resolution_model: the InterlockingResolution structure returned by resolveTrain, carrying interlockingId, routeId, trainId, trainPath, category, guardId, resolutionStrategy, reason.
Source name: Interlocking route resolution returns structured metadata, not a bare trainId (Bun).

splitSuggestion.then: Judge route/train category agreement against the target train's `category` field, never a digit parsed out of the identity validation.
